def convert_timestamp(frame_idx):
    assert 0 <= frame_idx < video.num_frames

    sec = int(video.num_secs * (frame_idx / video.num_frames))
    timestamp = f"{sec // 3_600:02}:{sec // 60 % 60:02}:{sec % 60:02}"

    return timestamp

p_frame_idxs = list(range(0, len(palette), 4 * 60 * 10))
timestamps = [convert_timestamp(6 * p_frame_idx) for p_frame_idx in p_frame_idxs]
In [5]:
def smooth(a, *, window_size=240, half_life=None):
    assert window_size <= len(a)

    if half_life is None:
        kernel = np.ones(window_size) / window_size
    else:
        kernel = np.cumprod(np.full(window_size, 2 ** (-1 / half_life)))[::-1]
        kernel /= kernel.sum()

    a = np.convolve(a, kernel, mode="same")

    return a

frame_idx = 66_000

frame = video[frame_idx]
frame = cv.cvtColor(frame, cv.COLOR_BGR2RGB)

p_frame = palette[frame_idx // 6]
p_frame = np.broadcast_to(p_frame[:, np.newaxis, :], (6, 25_600, 3)).reshape((960, 160, 3))
p_frame = cv.cvtColor(p_frame, cv.COLOR_BGR2RGB)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(9, 6), width_ratios=[1920, 160])

axes[0].set_title(f"frame at {convert_timestamp(frame_idx)}")
axes[0].set_xticks([])
axes[0].set_yticks([])
axes[0].imshow(frame)

axes[1].set_title("palette")
axes[1].set_xticks([])
axes[1].set_yticks([])
axes[1].imshow(p_frame)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

p = palette
p = np.broadcast_to(p.transpose((1, 0, 2))[:, np.newaxis], (6, 1_000, len(palette), 3)).reshape(6_000, len(palette), 3)
p = cv.cvtColor(p, cv.COLOR_BGR2RGB)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 6))

ax.set_title("palette across time")
ax.set_xticks(p_frame_idxs)
ax.set_xticklabels(timestamps)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.imshow(p)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

p = palette
p = cv.cvtColor(p, cv.COLOR_BGR2HLS)[..., 1].mean(axis=1)
p = smooth(p, half_life=4 * 10)
p2 = np.broadcast_to(p[np.newaxis, :], (1000, len(palette))).astype(np.uint8)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 3), height_ratios=[1, 2])

axes[0].set_title("lightness across time")
# axes[0].set_xticks(p_frame_idxs)
# axes[0].set_xticklabels(timestamps)
axes[0].set_xticks([])
axes[0].set_yticks([])
axes[0].imshow(p2, cmap="bone")

axes[1].set_xlim(0, len(palette))
axes[1].set_xticks(p_frame_idxs)
axes[1].set_xticklabels(timestamps)
axes[1].plot(np.arange(len(palette)), p)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
